data.text:
[3:45PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along the Cele stretch towards Pako is moving smoothly, with the return journey also free-flowing. The Cele linked bridge inward Ijesha, as well as the return route, is clear. Movement through the inner part of Nwachukwu Drive connecting to Cele is also smooth in both directions.

Ago Palace Road, both inward and outward towards Apple Junction, shows encouraging traffic flow. Ibeh Road (Apata) inward from Transformer Junction to Ilasa Under Bridge Service Lane is also free in both directions. Traffic along the inner part of Ire-Akari leading to Osolo Road is moving well on both sides.

The Oke Afa–Pako–Kogberegbe–Ile Ibadan–Ishaga College–Omonide–Aye–Limca Junction corridor, inward Lasutech Roundabout and towards Daleko Bridge, is experiencing slow movement due to ongoing market activities at Daleko.

Meanwhile, traffic is flowing freely from Five Star through Iyana Isolo and Iyana Itire inward Ijesha Express, covering both the main carriageways and service lanes. At the moment, there are no reported impediments in these areas.

[4:24PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic descending from CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal is experiencing slow movement due to market activities and a high influx of vehicles. However, immediately after Offin Canal towards Eko Bridge by the NEPA intersection, movement is smooth.

Traffic on Eko Bridge by NEPA inward CMS Bridge is flowing well. Similarly, the route descending from Carter Bridge into Ebute-Ero Market through Leventis and the UBA Roundabout, connecting both the inner and outer Marina, is clear.

There is slow movement along the Broad Street stretch to Apongbon, particularly underneath the bridge leading to Offin Canal Market.

At present, there are no reported impediments. Our personnel are on ground effectively managing the situation.
